name: The Lighthouse
summary: A lighthouse lit by the Acme mark sweeps a sea of live numbers; the beam reveals one hidden rock and the keeper turns the release back.
look: A minimal deep-teal night sea where each wave is a row of mono numbers on a sine path. A white, teal-banded lighthouse casts a soft volumetric beam that brightens the numbers it touches and reveals coral-edged rocks.

components.name: Lighthouse
components.role: tower with teal bands; the Acme mark is the lamp

components.name: Volumetric beam
components.role: gradient cone that doubles as a reveal mask

components.name: Number waves
components.role: rows of live metrics on phase-shifted sines

components.name: Rocks
components.role: hidden anomalies, coral once lit, teal outline once cleared

components.name: Release boat
components.role: the deploy heading for trouble, then turning back

components.name: Keeper's card & harbour lights
components.role: the human decision and the calm ending

motion.name: Beam sweep
motion.how: rotation yoyo ±40° over 4 s (two bars at 120 BPM), sine.inOut, crossing centre on each bar line

motion.name: Mask reveal
motion.how: numbers and rocks exist only inside the beam's clip; rocks keep a 40% outline after it passes

motion.name: Wave drift
motion.how: per-row textPath startOffset drift, 8 s loop, rows a quarter phase apart

story: Hook: a dark sea of numbers, an unlit lighthouse, and a release boat that hit a rock found Friday 17:40. Reveal: the lamp room (the Acme mark) ignites on the drop and the beam reveals 'Acme Pulse'. Proof: the beam sweeps the numbers and surfaces a coral rock ahead of release #2231, labelled 'Checkout conv. −18% · since 09:42 · after deploy #2231'; the keeper in the harbour taps Roll back and the boat curls away. CTA: calm sea, 'Caught before customers noticed.', harbour lights, Start free.
adapt: Fill the sea with your own numbers (orders, jobs, balances), name the rock after the risk your product catches, and make the boat whatever you ship.

references.note: SVG beam that reveals hidden text through a mask

fit.risk: Lonely night imagery can suggest AI running unattended; always put the human keeper in the harbour.
